title: National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5755-1995
source_id: ס״ח תשנ״ה, 210 (further publication at ס״ח תשנ״ה, 327); Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000198; Wikisource page חוק הביטוח הלאומי
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page חוק הביטוח הלאומי. Its heading prints the title as חוק הביטוח הלאומי [נוסח משולב], התשנ״ה–1995. The metadata box gives the first Sefer HaChukim citations as 'ס״ח תשנ״ה, 210' and 'ס״ח תשנ״ה, 327' and links to Knesset lawitemid 2000198. The page states the consolidated version was made on 3 April 1995 (ג׳ בניסן התשנ״ה), replacing the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5728-1968 and the National Insurance Law [Temporary Provision], 5751-1991, and that it took effect on 1 October 1995 (ז׳ בתשרי התשנ״ו). The amendment list runs from 1954 through to תשפ״ו (2026), i.e. the consolidation is maintained to the current Hebrew year.
notes: This is the single most important Israeli social-security statute and it carries BOTH sides of the system: insurance contributions (דמי ביטוח) and the benefit branches (old-age and survivors, disability, work injury, maternity, unemployment, children, long-term care, income-related supplements). It is therefore listed twice, once under Pensions/social security and once under Government benefits, as the instructions direct. It is a Knesset Law in consolidated-version form, not an Ordinance. Note that a 'נוסח משולב' (consolidated version) is itself an enacted official text, unlike the Wikisource consolidation. The Law is heavily amended and carries many temporary provisions (הוראת שעה); anyone encoding it must fix a point-in-time date.
